{"type":"thought","data":"The match is Real Sociedad"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus Deportivo A "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Coruña on October 11,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2026 at 14:15 UTC."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.235 for a draw aligns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" closely with Sofascore's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 25% estimate. Both "}
{"type":"thought","data":"teams are tied at 10"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points after seven "}
{"type":"thought","data":"games. Deportivo has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" drawn four of its last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" seven matches, giving"}
{"type":"thought","data":" them a strong draw "}
{"type":"thought","data":"rate."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReal Sociedad has "}
{"type":"thought","data":"drawn only once in its"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last seven games. Deportivo"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has been unbeaten away"}
{"type":"thought","data":" since February. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" historical head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record at Anoeta shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 25% draw rate, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Real Sociedad won the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last three top-flight meetings, including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 5-0 victory. Injuries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are also being checked."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReal Sociedad is missing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" several key players: Zubeldia, Odriozola,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Óskarsson, Aramburu,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Fort, and Martín. Deportivo"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has one injury and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"one absence. Real Sociedad's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last match was a 3-2"}
{"type":"thought","data":" victory over Valencia."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Both teams have been"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scoring and conceding"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals at roughly equal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rates."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReal Sociedad concedes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.86 goals per game,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" making it a leaky defense."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Deportivo has kept "}
{"type":"thought","data":"no clean sheets. La "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Liga draws historically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" run about 25 to 28 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"percent, so the market's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 23.5 percent is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below average. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"draw seems underpriced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because Deportivo's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" high draw rate and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the evenly matched points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" make this an even contest."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDeportivo has only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" one loss all season,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so it is unlikely to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lose. Real Sociedad"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is missing several "}
{"type":"thought","data":"key players and is weakened."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The edge to a draw "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is slight."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 76.5 percent No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw price reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Real Sociedad's home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" advantage. The team"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has won seventeen of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the last twenty-six"}
{"type":"thought","data":" meetings at Anoeta,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and its last three "}
{"type":"thought","data":"top-flight encounters were victories. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 3-2 win over Valencia"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests a high-event"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match, which favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a decisive result over"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA quick Poisson model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being run to estimate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the expected goals."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Combined goal expectations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are high, which would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower the draw probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Home advantage multipliers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are being applied to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the attack and defense"}
{"type":"thought","data":" figures."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Poisson model "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is being refined with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" league-average goals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" per team set at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.3. Real Sociedad's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" attack and defense "}
{"type":"thought","data":"strengths are calculated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" relative to that benchmark."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The initial expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals estimate for "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the away team seems "}
{"type":"thought","data":"too high, so a simpler"}
{"type":"thought","data":" blended approach using"}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Athletic data is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" being tried instead."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe blended expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals model contradicts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 62 percent home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win odds. A Poisson"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 8 percent is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" being calculated using"}
{"type":"thought","data":" λ_home at 1.55 and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"λ_away at 0.95. More"}
{"type":"thought","data":" specific data on home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form, away form, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" actual betting odds is needed."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Poisson draw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 24 percent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" across several expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals scenarios. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price of 0.235, so the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmaker consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already reflects a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reasonably open game."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.235 price is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" extremely close to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the independent model,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so there is little "}
{"type":"thought","data":"mispricing to exploit."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The focus shifts to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" maximizing payout against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other agents. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100-token bet on Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would return roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 426 tokens if it wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yielding a profit of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 326."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of both sides is zero,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the only way to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"win is to find an edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The user's prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 2-5 with a net loss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 271 tokens. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"instruction to pick "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" parsed as either the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or the highest payout."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" interpreted as the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"correct outcome, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" just the highest payout."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to be right"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value against the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents."}

A Coruna LIVE 11/10/2026 | Football - Flashscore\n\n# Real Sociedad v Dep. A Coruna (11/10/2026)\n\n[Favorites\n\n-](/favorites/)\n\n[Football](/)[ASEAN Cup](/football/asia/fifa-asean-cup/)[Basketball](/basketball/)[Tennis](/tennis/)[Badminton](/badminton/)[Volleyball](/volleyball/)[Handball](/handball/)[Cricket](/cricket/)\n\nMore\n\nAD \n\n**Two teams who have had solid starts to the season will look to kick on again after the international break as [Real Sociedad](/team/real-sociedad/jNvak2f3/) take on [Deportivo A Coruña](/team/dep-a-coruna/Q51ZzMS6/).**\n\n## Match News and Current Form\n\nAnder Barrenetxea’s last-gasp goal sent Real Sociedad into the international break on a high with a thrilling 3-2 win over Valencia. That was the third victory of the league season for Pellegrino Matarazzo’s men (D1, L3), leaving them five points better off than at the same stage in either of their last two campaigns, but they’ve had to settle for a mid-table position after losing each of their three league games against clubs starting this round above them in the table. That’s a concerning place to be in given their next opposition, especially as there's not a lot of advantage to be drawn from playing at home, given Sociedad are on a miserable run of one win from their last eight home games across all competitions (D3, L4).\n\nDeportivo de A Coruña’s return to the top flight after an eight-season absence is going better than expected after losing just once so far (W2, D4). That equals their fewest number of defeats at this stage of a La Liga campaign this century, with particular success coming from earning five points from losing positions, the joint-second most in the division ahead of this round. One of those came from a 1-1 draw with Real Betis before the international break, and Antonio Hidalgo’s men will now attempt to extend an unbeaten away record that stretches back to March (W4, D5), making them one of four La Liga teams yet to lose on the road going into the round (W1, D2).\n\n## Head-to-Head History\n\nAfter winning each of the last three top-flight H2Hs, Real Sociedad are looking to register four straight La Liga victories against Deportivo for the first time.\n\n![Win Probability](https://livesport-ott-images.ssl.cdn.cra.cz/r900xfq60/73459633-af38-43fc-b414-9929bc2e78e6.jpg \"Win Probability\")\n\nWin ProbabilityOpta by StatsPerform\n\n## Hot Stats and Streaks\n\nOnly one La Liga team had won more corners than Real Sociedad’s 51 ahead of this round.\n\nSix of Sociedad's eight competitive games this term produced at least five yellow cards.\n\nDeportivo conceded exactly one goal in a league-high six matches this term.\n\nSix of Deportivo’s seven La Liga fixtures this season saw both teams score.\n\n## Key Players to Watch and Missing Players\n\nReal Sociedad’s **[Jon Aramburu](/player/aranburu-jon/vNTtZiAr/)** has committed a pre-round league-high 25 fouls, picking up three yellow cards in the process. Going into this round, only one player had more shots on target without scoring than Deportivo’s **[Jonathan Asp Jensen](/player/asp-jonathan/A7cWLnKO/)** (six), and five of his nine goals last term came between the 70th and 75th minute.\n\nReal Sociedad will have to make do without the suspended **[Orri Óskarsson](/player/oskarsson-orri-steinn/K2gCwDJE/)**, while **[Héctor Fort](/player/fort-hector/0l4CHjYp/)** is a major doubt. Deportivo are hoping to have **[Lorenzo Amatucci](/player/amatucci-lorenzo/4jCqyBoe/)** available, but **[Marc Casadó](/player/casado-marc/tAhLmeJb/)** is out.\n\nFor all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.\n\n## Betting Analysis\n\nNeither of these teams have been particularly proficient at keeping clean sheets, so **[both teams to
